cost_registry_line: CM-PILOT-BYVGEN-SAGEMAKER-BINDINGS-2026-001 Medumba GENERALISATION experiment: fresh 3,000-step LoRA from the unadapted base on data version byvgen1 (2,895 Medumba training clips from 64 speakers, 4.4895 h; 15 speakers held out entirely). Worst case $3.20 on-demand (7,200 s ceiling), below the $10 calibration tier. Expected $1.82-2.31 but the estimate is SOFT - these clips average 5.58 s against the capacity probe's 4.43 s and step time scales with audio length. The experiment's additional runtime is capped at $6.40 across three jobs; $0.13 used by the base comparator.

data_version_pins.split_rule: sha256('byv-genz-2026/'+speaker_id) ascending, first 15 speakers held out
data_version_pins.why: MEDZEN_MANIFEST_VERSION names a version; it does not pin its CONTENT. The dispatcher verifies these against live S3 before launching.

managed_spot_reason: account spot quota for ml.g6.xlarge is 0; on-demand ceiling keeps worst case below the $10 calibration tier
worst_case_basis: 7,200 s ceiling on ml.g6.xlarge at $1.60/h on-demand = $3.20. 3,000 steps x 16 = 48,000 draws over 2,895 clips = about 16.6 passes, a deliberately different regime from the capacity probe's ~256 passes over 150 clips. The ceiling is the cap, not an estimate.
